lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
teamhub: 556 B beyond the first copy, @nextcloud/initial-state 556 B.
admin: 556 B beyond the first copy, @nextcloud/initial-state 556 B.
personal: 556 B beyond the first copy, @nextcloud/initial-state 556 B.
3 files belong to no page of this build, 17,914 B in total:
vite-personal.chunk.css, 7,875 B: a bundler chunk that no stylesheet imports and no script of this build names, so nothing loads it.
vite-serviceTeams.chunk.css, 4,889 B: a bundler chunk that no stylesheet imports and no script of this build names, so nothing loads it.
vite-widget-tokens.chunk.css, 5,150 B: a bundler chunk that no stylesheet imports and no script of this build names, so nothing loads it.
A build does not necessarily clear its output directory first, so these are the remains of an earlier one. make dist-clean removes them.
All 4 pages load the same 2 files: 6,493 B raw, 1,956 B gzip, 71.2 % of the smallest page (filesactions, 9,124 B).
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (135 packages, 1,230 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
